segments.summary: Reviewed CRAU-071 through CRAU-077 line by line. The window has clear scope, ownership, and negative constraints, but leaves material creation races, state schemas, confirmation evidence, identity lifecycle, image trust, and cross-document vocabulary enforcement unspecified.

Reviewed CRAU-078 through CRAU-084 line by line. Initial non-goals are explicit, while projection events, shared routes, help delivery, secret and confirmation oracles, end-to-end cases, and blocked-payload recovery remain insufficiently typed or falsifiable.

Reviewed CRAU-085 through CRAU-090 line by line. Coasts authority is tightly bounded, but operation transitions, promotion atomicity, deterministic drift, fail-closed access snapshots, and Kubernetes action/session authority require normative schemas and negative-path oracles.

Reviewed CRAU-091, CRAU-092, CRAU-001, migration coverage, and both FABLE addenda line by line. The retired bridge is explicit, but the whole-MVP family matrix and Docker/Hosts route are not yet schema-complete, and the template-repository transition row remains explicitly deferred.
